images.title: Grow the denominator to 100
images.purpose: Show 29 m shared among 4 by turning 29/4 into an equivalent fraction with denominator 100.
images.composition: A large equivalent fraction step in the centre with × 25 arrows above and below, and a thin ribbon cut into 4 equal parts along the bottom; generous white space.
exact_structure: Centre: the fraction 29/4 in teal #0072B2, a curved amber #E69F00 arrow over the top from 29 to 725 labelled × 25, and a matching curved amber arrow under the bottom from 4 to 100 labelled × 25, ending at the fraction 725/100 in teal.
To the right: = 7.25 in reddish purple #CC79A7.
Bottom: a horizontal teal #0072B2 ribbon with a grey #6B7280 bracket above it labelled 29 m, split by thin white gaps into exactly 4 equal pieces, each piece labelled 7.25 m underneath (4 labels).
rejection: any multiplier other than 25 or any result other than 725/100 and 7.25
the ribbon not split into exactly 4 equal pieces
the × 25 shown on only the numerator or only the denominator
images.takeaway: Multiply the numerator and denominator by the same number to reach 100, then read the decimal off.
images.description: 29/4 becomes 725/100 by multiplying top and bottom by 25, which equals 7.25; below, a 29 m ribbon is cut into 4 equal pieces of 7.25 m.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video on Neenu's ribbon shared between 2 and among 4.
images.teaching_notes: Point to the two matching × 25 arrows and stress that top and bottom are multiplied by the same number.

image_decisions.why: The equivalent fraction step is the method, and the ribbon keeps the answer tied to the sharing story.
